forum.title: Sportsbook
forum.points_only: Virtual points only: no real money, no deposits, no cash-outs.
forum.points_only_long: Everything here is played with virtual points. They have no cash value, can't be bought, sold or withdrawn, and exist only on this forum.

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.explain: Members bet against each other here. A backer picks a side at a price they name; anyone can lay it, putting up the backer's winnings against the backer's stake. Whoever is right takes both.

offer.explain: Match any part of the stake. You risk the backer's winnings on that part, and win it if the pick loses.
offer.cancel_confirm: Withdraw this offer? Anything still unmatched comes back to you.
offer.make_help: Back a pick at your own price. Your stake is held until someone matches it, you withdraw it, or the game starts.

offer.preview: If you're right, you win {win} on your {stake}.

admin.points_only: Longshot is played with virtual points only. There are no deposits, no withdrawals and no way to buy points through it. Points come from the starting balance, the weekly allowance and staff grants — or, if you choose, from FoF Gamification.

settings.currency_help: FoF Gamification points are the points members earn from votes; betting spends and pays them. Longshot's own balance is separate from them.
settings.currency_help_unavailable: To bet FoF Gamification points instead, install a version of FoF Gamification with point grants.
settings.currency_name_help: Shown after amounts, e.g. 1,000 coins. Leave empty for "points".
settings.starting_balance_help: Given once, the first time a member opens the sportsbook.
settings.allowance_help: Collected the first time a member visits in a week (from Monday, UTC). Groups can raise it below.
settings.allowance_topup: Top the balance up to it
settings.daily_limit_help: The most a member can stake in a day, on bets and the exchange together. 0 for no limit.
settings.max_payout_help: Stake plus winnings. Parlays that would pay more are refused.
settings.accept_better_odds_help: When a price moves in the member's favour between seeing it and betting, take the bet at the new price instead of asking them to confirm.
settings.public_history: Show members' settled bets to others
settings.public_history_help: Open bets are never shown to anyone else. Members can still make theirs private.
settings.picks_missing: Install and enable Picks (ernestdefoe/picks) to offer real games automatically, priced from ESPN and settled from Picks' final scores. Without it, you set up events by hand below.
settings.picks_import_help: Each game gets a moneyline, a spread and a total. Games are checked every 30 minutes.
settings.feed_odds_help: Lines and prices are refreshed every 30 minutes until kickoff. Take a market off the feed to price it yourself.
settings.auto_void_days_help: A game Picks never finishes (postponed, cancelled) is voided and every stake returned. 0 to leave them for you.

book.delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Nothing was placed on it.

event.linked_help: This game comes from {source}: its teams and kickoff follow the feed. Lock it to edit them, or suspend its markets to stop bets early.
event.locked_help: Locked: no sync changes its sides, kickoff or status, and no feed settles it: enter its score yourself. Prices still follow the feed on markets that do.

feed.title: Data providers
feed.help: Longshot can run the book by itself: games imported a few days ahead, priced until kickoff, closed when they start, settled from final scores, and branded with team logos, colours and league badges (fetched once, resized and served from your forum). Providers are tried in order and skipped while they fail or have spent their budget. ESPN needs no key; the others light up when you add one.
feed.follow_help: Games in these leagues are brought in automatically. Leagues your Picks extension plays are left to Picks.
feed.about_espn: Free, no key. ESPN's public scoreboards: every game, its status and score, one sportsbook's prices and the teams' logos and colours. Unofficial and unsupported by ESPN, so it is budgeted and paused when it misbehaves.
feed.about_apifootball: Soccer. Free plan: 100 requests a day. Fixtures, 90-minute results (so extra time never decides a bet) and Bet365 prices.
feed.about_oddsapi: Prices from many bookmakers for every league here. Free plan: 500 credits a month; a price check costs 3 credits, a results check 2, so it is only asked about games ESPN could not price.
feed.about_cfbd: College football lines for the games ESPN doesn't price. Free tier: 1,000 calls a month, shared with Picks if you use its key.
feed.about_sportsdb: Team badges, colours and league badges. Works without a key (ten teams per league, about 30 calls a minute); a supporter key gives every team.
feed.key_from_picks: Using Picks' key (type to use your own)
feed.paused: Paused after errors until {until}; the next provider is used meanwhile.

teams.title: Teams
teams.help: The teams your providers brought in. Fix a name, a colour or a logo here; an edited team is locked so syncs leave it alone.
teams.none: No teams in this league yet.
teams.name: Name
teams.logo_help: An image on ESPN's, TheSportsDB's or API-Football's servers (https). It is downloaded once, resized and served from your forum.

limits.title: Limits by group
limits.help: Leave a field empty to use the forum's default. A member in several groups gets the most generous value; a daily limit of 0 means none.

grant.title: Give or take points
grant.help: For prizes, corrections and the like. Use a negative number to take points away. Recorded in the member's history.

admin.finished: This event is already settled or void.
admin.names: Give the event a title, or both sides.
admin.starts: Give the event a valid start time.
admin.too_many_markets: An event can have up to 30 markets.
admin.unknown_market: A market or selection in the form no longer exists. Reload and try again.
admin.market_type: That market type isn't available for this event. Events without two sides take custom markets only.
admin.market_used: Bets or offers were placed on that market, so it can't be changed that way. Void it instead.
admin.line: Spreads and totals need a line in whole or half points.
admin.custom_label: Custom markets and their options need a name.
admin.custom_count: A custom market needs 2 to 40 options.
admin.selection_key: Every market needs both of its sides.
admin.odds: Odds must be a whole number of at least 100 either way, up to 10000.
admin.results: Give every option a result (win, lose or void). At least one must win, unless every one is void.
admin.score: Scores are whole numbers from 0 to 9999.
admin.event_used: Bets or offers were placed on this event, so it can't be deleted. Void it instead.
admin.limit: Limits are whole numbers from 0 up.
admin.amount: Give a whole number of points to add, or a negative number to take away, that the balance can cover.
admin.slow_down: A sync is already running. Try again in a minute.
admin.no_provider: There is no such data provider.
admin.test_slow_down: That provider was tested a moment ago. Try again in a minute.
admin.team_name: A team needs a name of up to 100 characters.
admin.team_logo: A logo must be an https address on ESPN's, TheSportsDB's or API-Football's image servers.
